authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Vegetarian / Non-Vegetarian Logo Declaration
citation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(2)
explanation: Every package of food shall carry a symbol: a green color filled circle inside a green square for Vegetarian food; or a brown color filled triangle inside a brown square for Non-Vegetarian food.

authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: FSSAI Logo and 14-Digit License Number
citation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(1)(d)
explanation: The FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number of the manufacturer or marketer must be displayed on the label.

authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Nutritional Information (per 100g/ml, per serve & %RDA)
citation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(3)
explanation: Nutritional information per 100 g or 100 ml, per single serve, and % contribution to Recommended Dietary Allowances (RDA) based on 2000 kcal diet must be provided, specifying Energy, Protein, Carbohydrate, Total Sugars, Added Sugars, Total Fat, Saturated Fat, Trans Fat, and Sodium.

authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Mandatory Food Allergen Declaration
citation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(4)
explanation: Food allergens (cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, eggs, fish, peanuts, tree nuts, soybeans, milk, and sulphite in concentration of 10 mg/kg or more) must be declared separately.

authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Date of Manufacture / Packaging & Expiry / Use By Date
citation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(7)
explanation: Date of manufacture/packaging and 'Expiry Date' or 'Use by Date' or 'Best Before' must be declared in DD/MM/YY or MM/YY format.

authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
citation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020, Regulation 5(10)
explanation: Net quantity shall be declared in standard units of weight (g, kg) or volume (mL, L) in accordance with the Legal Metrology Act.

authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
title: Front-of-Pack Nutrition Warning Cue (First Amendment 2026)
citation: FSSAI Labelling and Display (First Amendment) Regulations, 2026
explanation: High-in-sugar, salt, and saturated fat front-of-pack display requirement (Gazette notified, commencement scheduled for July 1, 2027). Under current October 2026 law, this is an informational preview and not an enforceable defect.
